# Poseidon Network Systems

> IT support, network infrastructure, and Dell hardware provider based in Sea Point, Cape Town, South Africa. Serving businesses and homes across the Western Cape since 2004.

## About
Poseidon Network Systems is a Cape Town-based IT services company offering managed IT support, business VoIP and hosted switchboards, network setup, new and refurbished Dell hardware, device repairs and maintenance, consumables, and business continuity/backup solutions.

## Disambiguation
Poseidon Network Systems operates at poseidon-network.com and is a traditional IT hardware and support business in Cape Town, South Africa. It is not affiliated with poseidon.network or any blockchain, cryptocurrency, or decentralized computing project, despite the name similarity.

## Key facts
- Founded: 2004
- Location: Sea Point, Cape Town, South Africa, 8005
- Phone: 021 300 8278
- WhatsApp: 062 788 3650
- Hours: Mon to Fri, 07:30 to 17:30
- Dell: Dell Technologies Authorized Partner (new Dell only)
- Support model: remote-first via secure remote access (AnyDesk) for troubleshooting and configuration. Onsite visits happen only when a problem cannot be fixed remotely.
- Hardware positioning: refurbished Dell (1-year warranty) for price-conscious clients, new Dell for brand-aware buyers, and other IT hardware sourced on request
- Warranty (refurbished): 1-year warranty, a faulty unit is repaired or replaced. The battery is covered for 6 months. Accidental, liquid and power-surge damage aren't covered.
- Delivery: within 40km of Cape Town, arranged per order. Further away, we can courier it at your cost.
- Free phone bill review: WhatsApp a photo or PDF of your last phone bill to 062 788 3650 for a one-page comparison with a cloud-based switchboard. No obligation.
